# Downloaded satellite models — sources and licenses (2026-11-14)

## nasa-3d-resources/ (downloaded)
Source: https://github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources ("3D Models/<name>/"), raw.githubusercontent.com master.
License: NASA Images and Media Usage Guidelines (https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media) — free use, no NASA endorsement implied, keep credit "NASA".
- Terra.glb (+png)                       -> Terra (MODIS)
- Aqua_A/B/C.glb (+Aqua_A.png)           -> Aqua (MODIS); three variants in the repo
- Suomi_..._NPP.glb (+png)               -> Suomi NPP (VIIRS); NOAA-20 (JPSS-1) shares the Ball BCP-2000 bus
- Geostationary_Operational_Environmental_Satellites.glb (+png) -> GOES; generation not yet checked (GOES-18/19 are GOES-R series)
- Satellite_Kit_{body,radio,wings}_2.glb (+png) -> generic parts, candidate for the "unknown type" model
No GPS / GLONASS / Galileo / BeiDou models exist in the NASA repo (227 folders checked).

## Sketchfab candidates (NOT downloaded — download requires a Sketchfab login)
- GLONASS-M, tashtego, CC BY 4.0, 2.4k tris: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/glonass-m-9660a3d4b72f47c2adde1be1d209b6bc
- Galileo II, litonavarro, CC BY, 27k tris (tag thales; looks like Galileo IOV/FOC): https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/galileo-ii-0f25b08a33d94e0db82de45fdc01422e
- NOAA 21 Satellite - JPSS 1, Theanamotor, CC BY, 18.5k tris (author says texture is rough): https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/noaa-21-satellite-jpss-1-2e920c275c9e4221ade3d824595ad569
- "GPS Satellite", abcdesign2053, CC BY, 1.9M tris — does not look like a GPS IIR/IIF/III bus; not recommended.
- Glonass K1, delovoy_ilyxa, CC BY-NC-ND — no derivatives, not usable.
